newsitem.title: UK: J.P. Morgan to lead manage Argentina peso Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: J.P. Morgan to lead manage Argentina peso Eurobond.

text.p: J.P. Morgan will lead manage Argentina's 500 million peso 10-year Eurobond, due to be launched on Wednesday in New York, traders in London said.
The deal will be priced to yield between 160 and 170 basis points over the bid price on Argentina's 2006 global dollar bond issue, they said.

Government officials in Argentina earlier said a 500 million peso 10-year Eurobond would be launched. The Eurobond was announced by Economy Minister Roque Fernandez at the World Economic Forum annual meeting in Davos Switzerland, they said.
On Tuesday, Moody's Investors Service rated Argentina's peso-denominated sovereign debt B1, the same as its foreign currency debt rating.
Argentina introduced a currency board system which pegs the peso to the dollar in 1992.
